title.en: Simulation: the street festival goes wrong
title.es: Simulación: imprevistos en la fiesta del barrio

es: Resolver un imprevisto comunitario: reportar lo que dijeron los vecinos, proponer un cambio con tacto y escribir un aviso formal.

teaching.en: Tom said that the generator had broken down.
teaching.es: Tom dijo que el generador se había averiado.
teaching.explanationEs: Said that + pasado perfecto: retrocedes el tiempo de lo que dijo la otra persona.
teaching.audioText: Tom said that the generator had broken down.

teaching.en: Mrs Lopez complained that the music was too loud.
teaching.es: La Sra. López se quejó de que la música estaba demasiado alta.
teaching.explanationEs: Complained that + oración retrocedida (is pasa a was): reportas sin añadir tu opinión.
teaching.audioText: Mrs Lopez complained that the music was too loud.

teaching.en: We would rather postpone the festival than cancel it.
teaching.es: Preferimos aplazar la fiesta antes que cancelarla.
teaching.explanationEs: Would rather + verbo base expresa una preferencia sin imponerla.
teaching.audioText: We would rather postpone the festival than cancel it.

teaching.en: Would you consider moving the stalls to the park?
teaching.explanationEs: Would you consider + -ing: propuesta con tacto, no una orden.
teaching.audioText: Would you consider moving the stalls to the park?

teaching.en: Notice: we apologise for the change, as the permit only allows music until ten.
teaching.es: Aviso: pedimos disculpas por el cambio, ya que el permiso solo permite música hasta las diez.
teaching.explanationEs: Aviso formal: Notice, we apologise for…, as + razón, sin contracciones.
segments: Notice: we apologise for the change, as
the permit only allows music until ten.
teaching.audioText: Notice: we apologise for the change, as the permit only allows music until ten.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase reporta lo que dijo Tom?

choices.text: Tom said me that the speakers have stopped working.
Tom said that the speakers stops working.
Tom said that the speakers had stopped working.

feedback.es: El reporte retrocede el tiempo (have stopped pasa a had stopped) y said no lleva persona.

hint.es: Comprueba el tiempo del verbo reportado y si said lleva persona.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se quejó de que la música estaba demasiado alta.»

feedback.es: Complained that + oración retrocedida reporta una queja.

hint.es: Es el verbo de reporte que expresa una queja.

origin.text: She ___ that the music was too loud.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Consideraría aplazar la fiesta hasta el domingo?»

answer.text: Would you consider postponing the festival until Sunday

feedback.es: Would you consider + -ing es la fórmula de la propuesta con tacto.

hint.es: Después de consider va un verbo con -ing.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su función.

pairs: Would you consider moving the stalls?
We would rather postpone than cancel.

feedback.es: Cada frase cumple una función distinta: reportar, proponer, disculparse o preferir.

prompt.es: Reporta lo que dijo la vecina, con retroceso de tiempos.

answer.text: Mrs Lopez complained that the stall was too close to her door.
accepted: Mrs Lopez complained that the stall was too close to her door.
Mrs Lopez said that the stall was too close to her door.
Mrs Lopez said the stall was too close to her door.
Mrs Lopez told us that the stall was too close to her door.
Mrs Lopez complained the stall was too close to her door.

feedback.es: El reporte cambia is por was y my por her.

origin.text: La Sra. López dijo: «The stall is too close to my door.» Escribe lo que dijo en estilo indirecto.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone el organizador.

choices.text: To move the festival to the next day.
To hold it in another town.

feedback.es: Would you consider holding the festival on Sunday propone cambiar la fiesta al domingo, el día siguiente.

origin.audio: We cannot use the park on Saturday. Would you consider holding the festival on Sunday instead?

prompt.es: Escribe el aviso para los vecinos: qué pasó, qué dijeron y qué propones.

answer.text: Notice to all neighbours. We apologise for the change, but the street festival has been postponed until Sunday. According to the caretaker, the generator broke down at six o'clock, and by eight the music had stopped. Tom told us that nobody had checked the generator, and Mrs Lopez complained that the music was too loud. We would rather postpone the festival than cancel it, as the permit only allows music until ten. Would you consider moving your stalls to the park on Sunday morning? Had the generator not broken down, the festival would have started today. Please contact the organisers if you need any help. Thank you for your understanding.
accepted: Notice to all neighbours. We apologise for the change, but the street festival has been postponed until Sunday. According to the caretaker, the generator broke down at six o'clock, and by eight the music had stopped. Tom told us that nobody had checked the generator, and Mrs Lopez complained that the music was too loud. We would rather postpone the festival than cancel it, as the permit only allows music until ten. Would you consider moving your stalls to the park on Sunday morning? Had the generator not broken down, the festival would have started today. Please contact the organisers if you need any help. Thank you for your understanding.

Notice for residents. We are sorry for the inconvenience: the festival will take place on Sunday instead of today. Leo explained that the generator had stopped working, and some neighbours complained that the music was too loud. We suggest that all stalls move to the park, and we would rather postpone than cancel, because the permit ends at ten. Would it be possible for you to arrive at nine on Sunday? Had the generator not failed, everything would have started on time. Please speak to the organisers if you have any questions. Thank you for your patience.

feedback.es: El aviso necesita disculpa, reporte fiel, propuesta con tacto y registro formal.

origin.text: Escribe un aviso para los vecinos: la fiesta del barrio se aplaza al domingo por la avería del generador y por el permiso de música. Incluye una disculpa, lo que dijeron Tom y la Sra. López (en estilo indirecto) y una propuesta con tacto.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase del aviso es más prudente sobre un rumor?

choices.text: The organiser apparently lost the permit, as the emails show.
The organiser allegedly lost the permit.
The organiser lost the permit, for sure.

feedback.es: Allegedly deja claro que nadie lo ha probado; las otras versiones lo presentan como un hecho.

origin.text: Neighbours say the organiser lost the permit, but nobody has any proof.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo acabó el concierto, según Leo.

choices.text: The speakers worked well all night.
The speakers failed, so the concert finished late.

feedback.es: Had the speakers worked + would not have finished so late implica que no funcionaron y el concierto acabó tarde.

origin.audio: Leo said that, had the speakers worked, the concert would not have finished so late.

prompt.es: Completa tres frases que mezclan lo aprendido en el bloque.

feedback.es: If it weren't for da la condición presente, suggested that + verbo base reporta una propuesta y of which une la frase.

sentences: If it ___ for the volunteers, the stalls would still be closed.
The organiser ___ that we move the stalls to the park.
The stalls, three of ___ are empty, will move.
origin.text: Pistas: «Si no fuera por los voluntarios…» · «El organizador sugirió que trasladáramos…» · «…tres de los cuales…»

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es más apropiada en un aviso formal?

feedback.es: Un aviso formal usa we apologise for…; las otras frases son demasiado informales.

prompt.es: Completa: «Ana dijo que los puestos ya estaban cerrados.»

feedback.es: El reporte retrocede el tiempo: were already closed o had already closed.

origin.text: Ana said that the stalls ___ already closed.

answer.text: We would rather postpone it than cancel it

feedback.es: Would rather + verbo base expresa la preferencia; than une las dos opciones.
